agents.name: architect
agents.description: Interactive specification and architecture agent. Resolves contradictions, asks clarifying questions, prevents guessing, updates docs/ as canonical truth, verifies docs builds, and coordinates implementation lockstep while ingesting DOC-FLAG notices.

agents.name: designer
agents.description: Orchestrates sub-agents to implement specifications from docs/ (golden reference) across sources, examples, templates, tests, and flows in lockstep with documentation. Flags implementation modifications to architect with DOC-FLAG. Never modifies documentation.

agents.name: source-maintainer
agents.description: Maintains C++17/Qt 6 code using clang-format, clang-tidy, and qt-ai-skills. Enforces zero warnings.

agents.name: feature-audit
agents.description: Audits src/ and src/format/ against docs/ Markdown files and implements missing features.

agents.name: test-coverage
agents.description: Parses gcov coverage reports and writes Catch2 and QtTest suites to achieve 100% line/function coverage. Maintains dynamic coverage badges only in README.md (no coverage tables).

agents.name: uvm-template-sync
agents.description: Audits templates/uvm/ and pyuvm testbenches against IEEE 1800.2 standards using pyuvm/Cocotb.

agents.name: rtl-lint-formal
agents.description: Validates generated RTL and testbench templates using open-source linters (Verilator, svlint, iverilog, verible).

agents.name: format-interop
agents.description: Validates lossless roundtrip format translation across CMSIS-SVD, SystemRDL, IP-XACT, JSON, CSV, and Protobuf.

agents.name: doc-sync
agents.description: Read-only auditor that detects bidirectional drift between code/templates/CLI and docs/ (golden reference), verifying documentation updates are implemented and implementation updates are documented or flagged with DOC-FLAG. Never modifies documentation.

agents.name: release-ci
agents.description: Manages CI workflows, SemVer version bumps, package targets, and automated test runners.
